Thanks again for the time today — really appreciated the demo and the candid discussion around volume and latency needs. Quick recap and the items we agreed to follow up on: 

- Redwood trial: provisioning a 2-week dedicated evaluation for the Acme Analytics data ingestion use case.
- Primary success criteria: sustained 50 qps at p95 < 220ms and cost target under $0.006/token for embeddings-heavy workloads.
- Procurement path: you mentioned procurement usually pays via PO for tools over $25k/year — can you confirm whether this engagement will be PO or card? Also, is AWS Marketplace an option you'd prefer?

Next steps from our side:
1) I'll loop in our procurement lead Marissa and share the vendor setup packet (W-9, vendor form, banking details) and the DocuSign link for the trial agreement.
2) You can reply with the procurement contact at Acme (if different from Tom) and an estimated timeline for PO approval.

Attachments: vendor packet (PDF) — will follow in a separate email from Marissa.

If PO is the path, Marissa can work with your team directly to speed vendor onboarding. If Marketplace is easier, we can route through AWS Marketplace but it adds a listing lead time (usually 2-3 weeks).

Open to jumping on a quick 15-min call tomorrow if helpful to line up contacts.

Hi Samantha / Tom —

Thanks for the heads up — looping in procurement to get you onboarded quickly. Below is what we typically need for vendor setup (PO path). I've attached a vendor packet and our standard W-9 for US entities.

Required to kick off vendor setup (please provide):
- Completed vendor intake form (attached: vendor_packet.pdf) — company legal name, tax id (EIN), address, point of contact for invoicing.
- Signed W-9 (attached if you prefer to return a signed copy; otherwise we can accept a PDF of your executed W-9).
- Banking details for ACH payments (bank name, routing/account or remittance instructions) — optional if Acme prefers to pay by corporate card, but required for PO+ACH.
- If you operate outside the US, provide W-8 BEN/W-8 BEN-E as applicable.
- If you plan to use AWS Marketplace, let us know early (marketplace invoicing has slightly different terms).

Timeline: once we have the completed packet and W-9, vendor onboarding typically takes 3-5 business days for internal approvals and vendor code creation, then we can issue the initial invoice to match your PO date.

Attachments:
- vendor_packet.pdf (vendor intake form, fillable) [Attachment: vendor_packet.pdf (application/pdf)]
- W-9 template (fillable) [Attachment: ACME_W9_signed.pdf (application/pdf) — placeholder for a signed copy if you return it]

Tom — if you want, I can send the DocuSign for the vendor agreement and the trial SOW so signatures can be completed electronically. Otherwise, feel free to upload the completed packet to your vendor portal and reply here.

Best,
